# Hash-locked CI tooling for .github/workflows/ci.yml and pages.yml (#751).
# One package, and deliberately one: `uv` is the installer that reads `uv.lock`,
# and everything those jobs go on to install comes from that lock with the
# sha256 uv checks on the way in. This file is the bootstrap; the lock is the
# surface. A second flat pin file listing ruff/build/coverage would be a second
# thing to keep in step with the lock, which is the mistake #751 is about.
#
# Target runtime: ubuntu-latest, Python 3.13, binary wheels only — the runtime
# the `lint`, `coverage` and Pages jobs set up, and the one the `release
# lockfiles resolve` CI job dry-runs. The wheel below is the manylinux x86_64
# one those runners resolve; if `ubuntu-latest` ever moves off x86_64 the
# dry-run fails on a pull request rather than the install failing on `main`.
#
# Every install here is --require-hashes --only-binary=:all:, so a line without
# a hash, or a wheel PyPI no longer serves, fails a pull request rather than a
# run. Dependabot keeps it moving: `.github/requirements` is already one of its
# `pip` directories, and it rewrites the hash with the version.
uv==0.13.5 \
    --hash=sha256:0548460d46c8667488b1f089e936f29f0edfb1cc753f9152ffbd8bc84a46aa20 \
    --hash=sha256:0e03f5717bdaaf5ab4e2df361d2395e36b515946f56ef4bed88801aeb9959fb0 \
    --hash=sha256:1fb29fc46ba12033e2ef95a95ac79d649e71bbb1358419bbbcbd19d86026ef2f \
